Check SPIRE server is running: kubectl get pod spire-server-0 -n dojo-sec-spiffe — it must be Running before you can register entries.

You need the node UID for the parentID: NODE_UID=$(kubectl get node -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.uid}') — then use it in the entry create command: -parentID spiffe://cluster.local/spire/agent/k8s_psat/kube-dojo/$NODE_UID

Full command: kubectl exec -n dojo-sec-spiffe spire-server-0 -- /opt/spire/bin/spire-server entry create -spiffeID spiffe://cluster.local/ns/dojo-sec-spiffe/sa/spiffe-sa -parentID spiffe://cluster.local/spire/agent/k8s_psat/kube-dojo/$(kubectl get node -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.uid}') -selector k8s:ns:dojo-sec-spiffe -selector k8s:sa:spiffe-sa
